text: PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 66 of Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 420057, situated in the Village of Udalupotha, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 614 Hunupolagedara in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Rideegama, in the District of Kurunegala, in the Province of North West, referred to in Notice No calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette 2281/07 of 23rd May, 2022 in terms of Section 55 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. P. C. D. Sigera, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 30th April, 2024.
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
